title: Item Bundle Interaction
description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Adds bundle-specific interactions and tooltip to the item. Requires a "minecraft:storage_item" component.

num_viewable_slots.title: Num Viewable Slots
num_viewable_slots.description:
The maximum number of slots in the bundle viewable by the plater. Can be from 1 to 64. Default is 12.

Sample values:
• black_bundle: 12
